summary: Frontend E2E test of the Admin 'Set Temporary Password' and Client 'Change Password' features, plus regressions. One real UI bug found and fixed: on /admin/cases/{id} the TempPasswordDialog showed up off-screen (dialog top=1449px in a 1080px viewport). On the admin list the backdrop only covered the content column. Cause: the parent <main class='fade-in-up'> keeps a transform, so it becomes the containing block for position:fixed. Fixed by rendering the dialog with a React portal on document.body, then re-tested: overlay is 0,0,1920x1080 and the dialog sits at top=406. After the fix, every requested flow passed.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the modal appeared off-screen or only partly dimmed the page because the fade-in-up transform on <main> broke position:fixed. It now renders via createPortal(document.body).

issues: Login.jsx sends the user to location.state.from without checking role. In one run the client briefly landed on /admin (the admin's previous route) after logging in. ProtectedRoute then shows the force screen or redirects to /portal, so nothing leaks, but the role should be checked before using 'from'.

action_items: Optional: in Login.jsx, ignore state.from when it is an /admin path and the user is not an admin.

Optional: other modals rendered inside <main class='fade-in-up'> with position:fixed may have the same containing-block problem. Audit them, or remove the leftover transform after the animation ends (e.g. animation-fill-mode: none, or end with transform: none).
critical_code_review_comments: The fade-in-up animation leaves a transform on <main>, which breaks fixed-position overlays nested inside it. Portals are the safe pattern.
Copy button: navigator.clipboard fails in headless/non-secure contexts and shows the 'Copy failed — select manually' toast. The fallback works as designed (the value is select-all).
verified_flows: Admin list: Temp password link visible next to Change; opens modal; Cancel/X close it; clicks on the modal or backdrop do not navigate to the case
Admin case detail: admin-temp-password-btn opens modal; Generate shows a password in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format; copy button and Done work
Client login with temp password shows force-password-change-screen; /portal, /account, /intake/{id} and /portal/new all show the force screen with no app header
Force-screen validations: mismatch, under 8 chars, same as current, wrong temp ('Current password is incorrect.')
Successful change shows the 'Password updated.' toast and the normal app
portal-change-password-link goes to /account#password and scrolls to change-password-section
Account change password: wrong current shows an error; success shows a toast and clears the fields; old password is rejected and the new one works on next login
Regression: name and email forms render on /account; admin list email Change runs both prompts and shows the 'Courtesy email sent.' success toast
